title: Why Sourdough Starter Gives Bread Rise and Tang
narration: Why does sourdough need that jar of starter? You might think that jar just gives your loaf its sour taste. But the jar holds wild yeast and bacteria in flour and water. That's more than flavor. In the dough, yeast makes gas. The dough traps that gas in bubbles, making the loaf rise. Bacteria make acids that give the bread its tang. That jar gives your loaf both its lift and its flavor. Save this before your next sourdough bake.
